entries.en: Our tabby cat fell asleep in the suitcase before I finished packing.
entries.zh: 我还没收拾好行李，我家的虎斑猫就在行李箱里睡着了。

entries.en: The tachina fly landed on the handle of the gardener's empty basket.
entries.zh: 那只寄蝇落在了园丁空篮子的提手上。

entries.en: She adjusted the aquarium camera until the tadpole shrimp was clearly visible.
entries.zh: 她调整水族箱里的相机，直到能清楚地看到那只鲎虫。

entries.en: A tail feather lay on the floor of the bird's empty nesting box.
entries.zh: 那只鸟空着的巢箱底部放着一根尾羽。

entries.en: The photographer moved her tripod to include the whole talipot palm.
entries.zh: 摄影师挪动三脚架，把整棵贝叶棕拍进了画面。

entries.en: The mechanic wiped the spilled tallow oil from the workbench.
entries.zh: 机修工擦掉了洒在工作台上的脂油。

entries.en: The worker carried a sack of tanbark into the old tannery.
entries.zh: 工人把一袋树皮鞣料搬进了旧制革厂。

entries.en: A patch of tansy mustard covered the ground beside the disused gate.
entries.zh: 废弃的大门旁长着一片羽叶播娘蒿。

entries.en: The tape grass swayed across the lower edge of the underwater camera's view.
entries.zh: 苦草在水下相机视野的下沿来回摆动。

entries.en: He spread the tar paper over the shed roof before the rain arrived.
entries.zh: 下雨前，他把沥青纸铺在了棚屋顶上。

entries.en: The gardener loosened the tie around the tara vine's stem.
entries.zh: 园丁松开了绑在软枣猕猴桃茎上的系带。

entries.en: The entomologist found a tarnished plant bug inside the folded collecting net.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家在折起的采集网里发现了一只美国牧草盲蝽。

entries.en: She left the tassel flower in its pot until the new bed was ready.
entries.zh: 新花坛准备好之前，她一直把那株一点红留在花盆里。

entries.en: The tawny owl turned towards the sound of our closing car door.
entries.zh: 听到我们关车门的声音，那只灰林鸮转过了头。

entries.en: A splash of tea rose softened the otherwise stark black-and-white design.
entries.zh: 一抹带黄色调的粉红色，使原本冷硬的黑白设计柔和了些。

entries.en: The telegraph plant arrived with a handwritten note from the nursery.
entries.zh: 那株舞草送到时，附有苗圃的一张手写便条。

entries.en: A fallen branch from the temple tree blocked the gardener's doorway.
entries.zh: 鸡蛋花树的一根落枝堵住了园丁的门口。

entries.en: A tent caterpillar crossed the glove she had left on the fence.
entries.zh: 一只天幕毛虫爬过了她留在围栏上的手套。

entries.en: The tent-caterpillar moth rested on the outside of the empty collecting jar.
entries.zh: 那只天幕毛虫蛾停在空采集罐的外壁上。

entries.en: The technician weighed the terbium metal sample and returned it to its container.
entries.zh: 技术员称量了铽金属样品，再把它放回容器。

entries.en: The inspectors arranged secure storage for the old tetraethyl lead samples.
entries.zh: 检查人员为那些旧的四乙铅样品安排了安全的储存地点。

entries.en: The instructor pointed to the third stomach on the model of the cow.
entries.zh: 教师指了指牛模型上的第三胃。

entries.en: The three-spined stickleback briefly disappeared behind the camera's measuring marker.
entries.zh: 那条三刺鱼短暂地消失在相机的测量标记后面。

entries.en: We replayed the footage to watch the thresher shark swim past the camera again.
entries.zh: 我们重放了录像，再看了一遍长尾鲨从相机前游过的画面。

entries.en: The thrush nightingale remained on the branch while we folded the tripod.
entries.zh: 我们折起三脚架时，那只鸫歌鸲仍停在树枝上。

entries.en: The model thunder lizard nearly touched the museum's ceiling.
entries.zh: 那具雷龙模型几乎碰到了博物馆的天花板。

entries.en: The gardener knelt beside the thyme-leaved speedwell to remove a piece of litter.
entries.zh: 园丁跪在百里香叶婆婆纳旁，捡走了一片垃圾。

entries.en: The laboratory repeated the thyrotrophic hormone measurement because the first result was unclear.
entries.zh: 由于第一次结果不明确，实验室重新测量了促甲状腺激素。

entries.en: The tiger cat retreated behind a wooden screen in the enclosure.
entries.zh: 那只虎猫退到了围栏区域里的一道木屏风后面。

entries.en: The broken fence had fallen across a tiger lily beside the path.
entries.zh: 倒下的围栏压在了小路旁的一株卷丹上。

entries.en: A tiger moth clung to the curtain while I opened the window.
entries.zh: 我开窗时，一只灯蛾紧抓着窗帘。

entries.en: The surveyor marked the timber tree on her map before moving uphill.
entries.zh: 测量员先在地图上标出了那棵成材木，再向山坡上走去。

entries.en: The timber wolf watched the keeper carry a bucket past its enclosure.
entries.zh: 那只大灰狼看着提桶经过围栏旁的饲养员。

entries.en: The tineid moth flew from the empty box onto the cabinet door.
entries.zh: 那只谷蛾从空盒子里飞到了柜门上。

entries.en: She wrapped the glass ornament in tissue paper before closing the gift box.
entries.zh: 她用薄纸包好玻璃饰品，再合上礼品盒。

entries.en: The student photographed the tobacco budworm beside a small ruler.
entries.zh: 那名学生在一把小尺子旁拍下了烟草夜蛾幼虫。

entries.en: A tobacco thrips crawled from the specimen tray onto the entomologist's glove.
entries.zh: 一只烟草蓟马从标本盘爬到了昆虫学家的手套上。

entries.en: The gardener shifted the bench away from the leaning toddy palm.
entries.zh: 园丁把长凳从那棵倾斜的酒棕榈旁挪开了。

entries.en: I stopped watering when I noticed a tomato hornworm on the hose.
entries.zh: 我注意到水管上有一只番茄天蛾幼虫，便停止了浇水。

entries.en: We tied the tomato plant to a new stake after the old one snapped.
entries.zh: 旧支柱折断后，我们把那株番茄绑到了新支柱上。

entries.en: The researcher examined the tooth shell under a lamp without removing it from the tray.
entries.zh: 研究员在灯下检查那只角贝，没有将它移出托盘。

entries.meaningZh: 上面发酵酵母〔酿造用语〕
entries.en: The brewer returned the damaged packet of top fermenting yeast to the supplier.
entries.zh: 酿酒师把那包破损的上面发酵酵母退给了供应商。

entries.en: The top onion beside the gate survived the gardener's accidental trampling.
entries.zh: 门边的那株珠芽圆葱被园丁不慎踩过后仍活了下来。

entries.en: The council refused to let the company store toxic waste beside the playground.
entries.zh: 地方议会不允许那家公司把有毒废物存放在游乐场旁。

entries.en: Her toy dog slept in a carrier beneath the train seat.
entries.zh: 她的小型狗睡在火车座位下的宠物箱里。

entries.en: Our toy poodle kept bringing its ball to the plumber's toolbox.
entries.zh: 我家的玩具贵宾犬不停地把球叼到水管工的工具箱旁。

entries.en: The restorer sealed the old bottle of train oil before moving the cabinet.
entries.zh: 修复师先封好那瓶旧鲸油，再搬动柜子。

entries.en: The solicitor found a folded sheet of transfer paper between two unsigned forms.
entries.zh: 律师在两张未签字的表格之间发现了一张折过的复写纸。

entries.en: She moved the transparent quartz sample onto a dark cloth for the photograph.
entries.zh: 她把透明石英样品移到深色布上拍照。

entries.en: The trap-door spider withdrew before I could focus the camera.
entries.zh: 我还没对好焦，那只活板门蛛就退了回去。

entries.en: The old trellis collapsed under the weight of the traveler's joy.
entries.zh: 旧棚架承受不住葡萄叶铁线莲的重量，倒塌了。

entries.en: A loose roof tile struck the traveler's tree outside the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 一块松脱的屋瓦砸中了温室外的旅人蕉。

entries.en: The gardener untangled the traveller's joy from the handle of the gate.
entries.zh: 园丁把葡萄叶铁线莲从门把手上解开了。

entries.meaningZh: 树枝；树叉〔计算机树结构的分支〕
entries.en: She collapsed the tree branch to hide the archived folders.
entries.zh: 她收起树结构中的那个分支，隐藏了归档的文件夹。

entries.en: The tree creeper vanished behind the trunk as I raised my binoculars.
entries.zh: 我刚举起望远镜，那只旋木雀就消失在树干后面了。

entries.en: A tree cricket escaped through the gap in the collecting box.
entries.zh: 一只树蟋从采集盒的缝隙里逃了出去。

entries.en: The tree frog sat on the latch, preventing us from closing the enclosure.
entries.zh: 那只树蛙坐在门闩上，让我们无法关上围栏门。

entries.en: We moved the damaged wheelbarrow away from the tree lupine.
entries.zh: 我们把损坏的独轮手推车从树羽扇豆旁移开了。

entries.en: The tree of heaven shaded the picnic table throughout our afternoon visit.
entries.zh: 我们下午游览期间，野餐桌一直处在那棵臭椿的树荫下。

entries.en: The artist painted a serpent coiled beneath the tree of knowledge.
entries.zh: 画家画了一条盘在智慧树下的蛇。

entries.en: She rescued the tree onion from a cracked pot and replanted it.
entries.zh: 她从裂开的花盆里救出了那株珠芽圆葱，重新栽好了。

entries.en: A tree sparrow perched on the sign above the closed ticket office.
entries.zh: 一只树麻雀停在已关门的售票处上方的招牌上。

entries.en: The tree squirrel peered into the empty flowerpot from a low branch.
entries.zh: 那只树松鼠从低矮的树枝上探头往空花盆里看。

entries.en: He rested the heavy toolbox on a tree stump while opening the gate.
entries.zh: 他开门时，把沉重的工具箱暂放在一个树桩上。

entries.en: The tree swallow flew past just as I lowered the binoculars.
entries.zh: 我刚放下望远镜，那只树燕就飞了过去。

entries.en: A tree swift remained on the branch after the other birds had left.
entries.zh: 其他鸟离开后，一只树雨燕仍留在树枝上。

entries.en: We waited for the tree toad to leave before lifting the fallen board.
entries.zh: 我们等那只雨蛙离开后，才抬起倒下的木板。

entries.en: The gardener photographed the tree tobacco before the fence repairs began.
entries.zh: 修理围栏之前，园丁拍下了那株树状烟草。

entries.en: A delivery van damaged the trifoliate orange beside the nursery entrance.
entries.zh: 一辆送货车损坏了苗圃入口旁的那株枳。

entries.en: She turned the trifoliolate leaf over to sketch its underside.
entries.zh: 她把那片三出复叶翻过来，画下它的背面。

entries.en: The laboratory rejected the trisodium orthophosphate because its container had been opened.
entries.zh: 实验室拒收了那份磷酸三钠，因为它的容器已被打开。

entries.en: The building contractor asked the supplier to collect the unused trisodium phosphate.
entries.zh: 建筑承包商请供应商收回未使用的磷酸三钠。

entries.en: The trainer led the trotting horse back to its stable after the race.
entries.zh: 比赛结束后，训练员把那匹快步马牵回了马厩。

entries.en: A separate slide held the true bacteria from the second culture.
entries.zh: 另一张载玻片上放着第二份培养物中的真细菌。

entries.en: A true bug clung to my sleeve as I walked away from the hedge.
entries.zh: 我从树篱旁走开时，一只蝽紧抓着我的袖子。

entries.en: The biologist isolated a true fungus from the spoiled sample.
entries.zh: 生物学家从变质的样品中分离出了一种真菌。

entries.en: The trumpet creeper had grown around the ladder left against the wall.
entries.zh: 凌霄花已经缠上了靠墙放着的梯子。

entries.en: The greenhouse worker moved the trumpet flower to reach the cracked pane behind it.
entries.zh: 温室工人挪开了那株开喇叭形花的植物，以便够到后面开裂的窗玻璃。

entries.en: The builders protected the trumpet vine while replacing the garden wall.
entries.zh: 施工人员重砌花园围墙时，保护好了那株凌霄花。

entries.en: The trumpeter swan approached the floating camera, then turned away.
entries.zh: 那只号手天鹅靠近漂浮的相机，又转身离开了。

entries.en: The enlarged photograph showed a damaged tube foot on the starfish.
entries.zh: 放大的照片显示，那只海星的一根管足受了损伤。

entries.en: The student placed the tuber root on a damp cloth before drawing it.
entries.zh: 学生把那条贮藏根放在湿布上，再画下它的样子。

entries.en: She bought a tuberous begonia to replace the plant her cat had knocked over.
entries.zh: 她买了一株球根秋海棠，替换被她家猫碰倒的那株植物。

entries.en: The nursery replaced the tuberous plant that had been damaged during delivery.
entries.zh: 苗圃换掉了那株在运送途中受损的块茎植物。

entries.en: A tufted titmouse landed on the railing beside my unattended notebook.
entries.zh: 一只黑额冠山雀落在栏杆上，就在我暂时放下的笔记本旁。

entries.en: The broken container leaked tuna oil onto the warehouse floor.
entries.zh: 破损容器里的金枪鱼油漏到了仓库地面上。

entries.en: The geologist packed the tundra soil separately from the rock samples.
entries.zh: 地质学家把冻原土和岩石样品分开装好了。

entries.en: The tundra swan remained visible after the mist had hidden the opposite bank.
entries.zh: 雾遮住了对岸后，我们仍能看见那只小天鹅。

entries.en: A kite was caught in the tung tree outside the school gate.
entries.zh: 一只风筝挂在了校门外的油桐树上。

entries.en: The workshop ordered a replacement tungsten steel blade for the old cutter.
entries.zh: 车间为那台旧切割机订购了一片替换用的钨钢刀片。

entries.en: The shepherd guided the tup into a separate pen before opening the main gate.
entries.zh: 牧羊人先把那只公羊赶进一个单独的羊圈，再打开大门。

entries.en: The turkey cock blocked the narrow path between the barn and the gate.
entries.zh: 那只雄火鸡挡住了谷仓与大门之间的狭窄小路。

entries.en: The old turkey oak lost a branch during the storm but remained standing.
entries.zh: 那棵老平滑栎在暴风雨中折了一根树枝，但仍然挺立着。

entries.en: We watched the turkey vulture through binoculars from the observation deck.
entries.zh: 我们在观景台上用望远镜观察那只红头美洲鹫。

entries.en: The cook left the turnip-rooted celery on the scales while answering the telephone.
entries.zh: 厨师接电话时，把块根芹留在了秤上。

entries.en: The grocer put the turnip-rooted parsley in a separate paper bag for me.
entries.zh: 杂货店老板替我把根用欧芹单独装进了一个纸袋。

entries.en: A tussock moth settled on the lamp shade after we opened the porch door.
entries.zh: 我们打开门廊的门后，一只毒蛾落在了灯罩上。

entries.en: The student sorted the two-winged insects into a separate specimen tray.
entries.zh: 学生把那些双翅昆虫分拣到了另一个标本盘里。

entries.en: The museum kept a small ingot of type metal beside the printing press.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一小块铅字合金锭放在印刷机旁。

entries.en: She fed a fresh sheet of typing paper into the old typewriter.
entries.zh: 她把一张新的打字纸装进了那台旧打字机。

entries.en: The tyrant bird flew across the clearing before I could take a photograph.
entries.zh: 我还没来得及拍照，那只霸鹟就飞过了林间空地。

entries.en: A tyrant flycatcher perched above the trail while we searched for the missing lens cap.
entries.zh: 我们寻找丢失的镜头盖时，一只霸鹟停在小径上方。

entries.en: The entomologist repositioned the tzetze fly specimen beneath the camera.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家重新调整了相机下那件采采蝇标本的位置。

entries.en: A trace of ultramarine blue remained on the painter's palette after cleaning.
entries.zh: 清洗后，画家的调色板上还留着一点群青。

entries.en: The umbrella bird disappeared behind a branch as our camera began recording.
entries.zh: 相机开始录像时，那只亚马孙伞鸟消失在一根树枝后面。

entries.en: The gardeners hung a temporary sign beside the umbrella magnolia during the exhibition.
entries.zh: 展览期间，园丁们在三瓣木兰旁挂了一块临时标牌。

entries.en: We moved the picnic blanket out of the umbrella pine's shadow.
entries.zh: 我们把野餐毯从那棵日本金松的阴影里移了出来。

entries.en: The umbrella plant stood beside the cracked ceramic basin in the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 温室里的那株伞莎草立在开裂的陶盆旁。

entries.meaningZh: 蘑菇的包膜〔完整包裹幼菇的膜〕
entries.en: The photographer angled the light to reveal a tear in the universal veil.
entries.zh: 摄影师调整光照角度，让包裹幼菇的膜上的一道裂口显现出来。

entries.en: The driver stopped at the next station because this one had no unleaded gasoline.
entries.zh: 司机在下一个加油站停了车，因为这家没有无铅汽油。

entries.en: The foreman refused the delivery because the bags of unslaked lime were torn.
entries.zh: 工头拒收了这批货，因为装生石灰的袋子破了。

entries.en: The researcher left a narrow path through the upland cotton for the camera crew.
entries.zh: 研究员在陆地棉田里留了一条窄道，供摄制组通行。

entries.en: The museum displayed the uranium ore in a sealed case approved for the exhibit.
entries.zh: 博物馆把铀矿石放在获准用于该展览的密封展柜里陈列。

entries.en: The laboratory transferred its sealed container of uranyl nitrate to a restricted storeroom.
entries.zh: 实验室把那只装着硝酸铀酰的密封容器移到了限制进入的储藏室。

entries.en: The veterinarian examined the bird's uropygial gland before completing the health record.
entries.zh: 兽医检查了那只鸟的尾脂腺，再填写健康记录。

entries.en: The engineer compared the worn vanadium steel shaft with an unused replacement.
entries.zh: 工程师把磨损的钒钢轴与一根尚未使用的替换轴作了比较。

entries.en: The varying hare paused beside the empty basket, then bounded away.
entries.zh: 那只变色兔在空篮子旁停了一下，便跳走了。

entries.en: The botanist removed the vascular plant from the damaged pot without breaking its roots.
entries.zh: 植物学家把那株维管植物从破损的花盆中取出，没有弄断它的根。

entries.en: The student traced a vascular ray on the enlarged image of the stem section.
entries.zh: 学生在放大的茎切片图像上描出了一条维管射线。

entries.en: She adjusted the microscope until the damaged vascular strand came into focus.
entries.zh: 她调整显微镜，直到能清楚地看到那条受损的维管束。

entries.en: The researcher separated the vascular tissue from the rest of the stem sample.
entries.zh: 研究员把维管组织从其余茎样品中分离了出来。

entries.en: The textile workshop returned the vat color that had arrived in a damaged drum.
entries.zh: 纺织车间退回了那桶运抵时包装受损的瓮染料。

entries.en: The carver made a replacement button from a small piece of vegetable ivory.
entries.zh: 雕刻师用一小块植物象牙做了一颗替换用的纽扣。

entries.en: The filter trapped the vegetable matter but allowed the muddy water to pass through.
entries.zh: 过滤器截住了植物性物质，让浑水流了过去。

entries.en: The damaged cushion was spilling vegetable silk onto the workshop floor.
entries.zh: 破损的坐垫里不断有植物丝散落到车间地面上。

entries.en: She hung the vegetable sponge beside the sink after washing the dishes.
entries.zh: 洗完碗后，她把丝瓜瓤挂在了水槽旁。

entries.en: The photographer took the picture after the velvet ant crawled onto the plain background.
entries.zh: 那只天鹅绒蚁爬到纯色背景上后，摄影师拍下了照片。

entries.en: A patch of velvet grass hid the metal peg that held the tent rope.
entries.zh: 一片绒毛草遮住了固定帐篷绳的金属桩。

entries.en: The aquarium keeper photographed the fish's injured ventral fin for the veterinarian.
entries.zh: 水族馆饲养员拍下了那条鱼受伤的腹鳍，供兽医查看。

entries.en: The vesper sparrow landed close enough for our camera to capture its reflection in the puddle.
entries.zh: 那只黄昏雀鹀落得很近，我们的相机拍到了它在水洼中的倒影。

entries.en: A vinegar eel crossed the microscope's field of view as I adjusted the light.
entries.zh: 我调整光线时，一条醋线虫穿过了显微镜的视野。

entries.en: The student drew the vinegar worm beside a scale bar in her notebook.
entries.zh: 那名学生在笔记本上画下了醋线虫，并在旁边画了比例标尺。

entries.en: The chemist circled the vinyl group in the proposed molecular structure.
entries.zh: 化学家在提出的分子结构式中圈出了乙烯基。

entries.en: The gardener left the viper's bugloss untouched while repairing the edging beside it.
entries.zh: 园丁修理旁边的花坛边沿时，没有动那株蓝蓟。

entries.meaningZh: 新羊毛〔未曾使用或回收的羊毛〕
entries.en: The weaver reserved the virgin wool for a blanket ordered by a new customer.
entries.zh: 织工把新羊毛留了出来，准备用来织一位新顾客订购的毯子。

entries.en: The technician inspected the vitreous silica window for scratches before installation.
entries.zh: 安装前，技术员检查了那块玻璃状石英窗片是否有划痕。

entries.en: The geologist wrapped the volcanic glass sample before placing it in the case.
entries.zh: 地质学家把火山玻璃样品包好，再放进箱子里。

entries.en: The sculptor chose a piece of volcanic rock with an unusually smooth surface.
entries.zh: 雕刻家选了一块表面异常光滑的火山岩。

entries.en: A wading bird stepped over the half-submerged branch beside our boat.
entries.zh: 一只涉禽迈过了我们船旁那根半浸在水中的树枝。

entries.en: The wall creeper moved out of sight as we reached the viewing platform.
entries.zh: 我们走到观景台时，那只旋壁雀移出了视线。

entries.en: The botanist photographed the wall fern before the masons began repairing the wall.
entries.zh: 泥瓦匠开始修墙前，植物学家拍下了那株水龙骨。

entries.en: We placed a temporary barrier around the wall pellitory during the paving work.
entries.zh: 铺路期间，我们在那株墙草周围设置了临时围挡。

entries.en: The wall rue remained undamaged after the old sign was removed.
entries.zh: 旧标牌拆下后，那株墙生铁角蕨仍完好无损。

entries.en: The children tied a ribbon around the walnut tree they had planted together.
entries.zh: 孩子们在一起种下的那棵核桃树上系了一条丝带。

entries.en: The wandering albatross flew so close to the camera that one wing filled the frame.
entries.zh: 那只漂泊信天翁从相机近旁飞过，一只翅膀占满了画面。

entries.en: He polished the old mirror with a piece of wash leather.
entries.zh: 他用一块擦拭用的可洗皮革擦亮了那面旧镜子。

entries.en: The factory sold its waste material to a nearby recycling company.
entries.zh: 工厂把废料卖给了附近的一家回收公司。

entries.en: The blocked pipe released waste matter onto the basement floor.
entries.zh: 堵塞的管道把废物排到了地下室地面上。

entries.en: She emptied the waste paper into a recycling bin before leaving the office.
entries.zh: 离开办公室前，她把废纸倒进了回收箱。

entries.en: The disposal contract required each waste product to be weighed before removal.
entries.zh: 处置合同要求每件废品在运走前都必须称重。

entries.en: A fallen sign had flattened the water arum beside the path.
entries.zh: 倒下的标牌压倒了小路旁的那株水芋。

entries.en: The water beetle swam beneath the floating leaf before I could photograph it.
entries.zh: 我还没来得及拍照，那只水甲就游到了漂浮的叶片下。

entries.en: The old water birch leaned over the bench where we had left our coats.
entries.zh: 那棵老水桦倾斜着，伸到了我们放外套的长凳上方。

entries.meaningZh: 蟑螂〔美式口语中的一种称呼〕
entries.en: A water bug disappeared beneath the refrigerator when I switched on the kitchen light.
entries.zh: 我打开厨房的灯时，一只蟑螂钻到了冰箱底下。

entries.en: The grocer weighed the water caltrop before tipping it into a paper bag.
entries.zh: 杂货店老板先给菱角称重，再倒进纸袋里。

entries.en: The water deer stepped away from the fence as the keeper approached.
entries.zh: 饲养员走近时，那只獐离开了围栏边。

entries.en: The botanist photographed the water dropwort beside the survey marker.
entries.zh: 植物学家在测量标记旁拍下了那株水芹。
